messages:
Nora T: Quick thread: we keep seeing churn when rollout metadata toggles cosmetic labels. Proposal: add a small "signature" field that captures canonical model surface (config+tokenizer+vocab) separate from release labels. Runtime can use signature diffs to decide eviction risk.

Ethan J: Love it. Signature could be simple: sha256 of canonicalized {model-config, tokenizer-spec, vocab-hash}. Keep the proto change additive and string-typed.

Maya C: we should also include a lightweight "impact_band" (low|medium|high) authors set during release. If signature differs but impact_band==low, runtime can do a warm promotion path instead of immediate evict.

Nora T: example fields on-wire (strings): signature:"sha256:aa11...", impact_band:"low", human_note:"vocab prune, no tokenizer change", est_mem_delta:"+120MB"

Ethan J: runtime sketch: if meta.compat_break == true -> evict immediate + alert. else if signature_changed(meta) -> consult tenant_policy: if strict -> evict; else if impact_band=="low" -> set soft_promote_deadline(now+default_window) and optionally kick small canary traffic. else schedule eviction.

Maya C: add a tiny "canary_pct" (stringified float) to metadata, default 0.0. During soft window, route that percentage to new signature to validate. Helps detect regressions without full unpin.

ops-bot: Note: adding signature, impact_band, canary_pct, est_mem_delta to rollout proto in staging. Additive only.

Nora T: telemetry: emit events signature_change_detected, soft_promote_started, soft_promote_reclaimed. Console should show the human_note and impact_band prominently for SRE/tenants.

Ethan J: GC pressure: global reclaim flag must override soft windows. If reclaim toggled, all warm/soft promotions should be canceled and models become eligible for eviction. Log reclaim reason in event metadata.

Maya C: QA suggestion: when canary_pct>0, create a small 'canary-check' expectation in Console (latency, basic fuzz tests) and fail the soft-promote if metrics deviate beyond threshold. Include pointers in human_note.

Nora T: action items: Maya -> draft RFC snippet with signature spec + examples; Ethan -> prototype signature computation in model build pipeline; Ops -> expose reclaim toggle + event schema; QA -> small canary-check pattern for Console.

Nora T: TL;DR: add signature + impact_band + optional canary_pct to rollout metadata, prefer soft-promotion with canary for low-impact signature changes, tenant strictness and global reclaim still win.
